AgentView.title: AgentView

BriefingItem.title: BriefingItem
BriefingItem.description: Tier 5 — one line of the Chairman's daily briefing.

ClarificationMode.title: ClarificationMode
ClarificationMode.description: Controls how an ambiguous query is handled (Req 2.4).

Clarify.title: Clarify
Clarify.description: Refinement needs the Commander to clarify (interactive mode, Req 2.5).

CleanedItem.title: CleanedItem
CleanedItem.description: The unit persisted to Postgres after Data Engineering (Req 14, 15).

ContextPreview.title: ContextPreview
ContextPreview.description:
Best evidence quote for a tracker (theme) + a relevance score (Core Feature §7.1).

Surfaced by `GET /api/trackers/{tracker}/context`. `score` is a real 0..1 semantic
relevance of the quote to the tracker concept — never a placeholder. Every preview is
anchored to a real `source_url`-backed item (no-orphan guardrail §12.6).

CouncilReport.title: CouncilReport
CouncilReport.description: The full Tier 3–5 output for one run, persisted as the latest snapshot.

DataEngReport.title: DataEngReport
DataEngReport.description: Batch outcome of a Data Engineering run (Req 7.4, 7.5).

DebateRecord.title: DebateRecord
DebateRecord.description: Tier 4 — the adversarial debate transcript + Chairman verdict.

DebateSideMeta.title: DebateSideMeta
DebateSideMeta.description: A debater's identity (the model family is shown in the UI).

DebateTurn.title: DebateTurn
DebateTurn.description: One logged turn of the Bull/Bear/Chairman debate (Req: full transcript).

DiscoveryResult-Input.title: DiscoveryResult
DiscoveryResult-Input.description: What the Discovery agent returns for a single topic query.

DiscoveryResult-Output.title: DiscoveryResult
DiscoveryResult-Output.description: What the Discovery agent returns for a single topic query.

EffectivePrompt.title: EffectivePrompt
EffectivePrompt.description: Exactly what an agent's next run sends as its system instruction.

Evidence.title: Evidence

LedgerRow.title: LedgerRow

MacroIndicator.title: MacroIndicator

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: Mental-model keys to enable; unknown keys are ignored

Prediction.title: Prediction
Prediction.description: Tier 5 — a resolvable prediction destined for the ledger (Req 7.3).

ProcessingFailure.title: ProcessingFailure
ProcessingFailure.description: A SourceItem that could not be processed/persisted — surfaced, not hidden.

PromptSection.title: PromptSection
PromptSection.description: One heading + body of a composed system prompt.

PromptView.title: PromptView
PromptView.description:
One editable block of an agent's system prompt, for the Agent Console.

`layer` is which part of the agent it is — "soul", "rules", "mental_model",
"personality", or "skill" (the task SOP) — and `agent` the roster id that owns it
(null for the council-wide soul/rules and the shared mental-model library).

ResolvedEntity.title: ResolvedEntity
ResolvedEntity.description: A canonical entity (ticker or macro entity) with the aliases that matched it.

SectorNote.title: SectorNote
SectorNote.description: Tier 3 — an Andie desk's daily Investment Highlights & Catalyst Note.

SkippedSource.title: SkippedSource
SkippedSource.description: A source/branch we could not ingest — surfaced, never silently dropped.

SourceItem.title: SourceItem
SourceItem.description: One discovered piece of content, normalized across sources.

StockTake.title: StockTake
StockTake.description: One analyst's view on a single ticker.

ThemeBasket.title: ThemeBasket
ThemeBasket.description: Tier 5 — a final thematic basket with the Chairman's conviction + hold period.

ToolView.title: ToolView
ToolView.description: One executable capability an agent can call (read-only in the console).

TranscriptSegment.title: TranscriptSegment
TranscriptSegment.description: A timestamped slice of a video transcript (seconds from start).
